# Client bundle byte identity (src/client/index.js == lib/client.js)

The host serves lib/client.js verbatim to the browser (src/client is a __ModuleLoader__
script, not compiler output), so the two files must be byte-identical: build-client.mjs
is a copyFileSync and test/client.spec.ts asserts equality.

$ sha256sum src/client/index.js lib/client.js
d290765594d62a3bcdb6a740a53a6d37c73b5f57d3d341051cc54bdcd5957d2a  src/client/index.js
d290765594d62a3bcdb6a740a53a6d37c73b5f57d3d341051cc54bdcd5957d2a  lib/client.js

$ cmp src/client/index.js lib/client.js && echo identical
identical

-- inside the packed tarball --
sha256 of package/lib/client.js:
  d290765594d62a3bcdb6a740a53a6d37c73b5f57d3d341051cc54bdcd5957d2a
sha256 of the source of truth src/client/index.js:
  d290765594d62a3bcdb6a740a53a6d37c73b5f57d3d341051cc54bdcd5957d2a

-- the installed bytes in the isolated profile --
  d290765594d62a3bcdb6a740a53a6d37c73b5f57d3d341051cc54bdcd5957d2a
$ cmp <tarball>/package/lib/client.js <installed>/lib/client.js
identical

-- every published lib/ file against the scratch rebuild of src/ --
$ for f in $(cd package/lib && find . -type f); do cmp ...; done
published lib files compared: 73, differing: 0

The build tree also has lib/**/*.map files that the tarball does not carry, because
package.json files[] publishes only 'lib/**/*.js' and 'lib/**/*.d.ts'. That is finding F2:
the published .js files still end with '//# sourceMappingURL=<name>.js.map' (36 of the 37
files; lib/client.js is the copied browser bundle and has no comment).
$ grep -c sourceMappingURL package/lib/index.js
1
$ tail -1 package/lib/index.js
ader.lastGood(),    });}//# sourceMappingURL=index.js.map
map files in the tarball: 0
